name: Pantai Malindo Half Marathon 2027
short_description: Pantai Malindo Half Marathon 2027 is on Sunday 31 January 2027 at SRJK(C) Yu Chye in Penang, over 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The Pantai Malindo Half Marathon 2027 is the first edition of this race, organised by Howei (M) Sdn Bhd from SRJK(C) Yu Chye, Penang, on 31 January 2027 at 5:00 am. It offers 21 km and 10 km distances. The organiser describes a flat, low-traffic course on fresh tarmac along the former mangrove coastline of Pantai Malindo, with a central bridge and the Balik Pulau Forest Reserve as a backdrop.

faqs.question: When does the Pantai Malindo Half Marathon 2027 start?
faqs.answer: The event starts at 5:00 am on Sunday 31 January 2027 at SRJK(C) Yu Chye, Penang. It offers 21 km and 10 km categories.

faqs.question: Where is race kit collection?
faqs.answer: Race kits are collected on 30 January 2027 from 10:00 am to 5:00 pm. The collection point is Decathlon, Gurney Paragon.
